st: On Thursday We Leave For Home
d: A man named Benteen leads a colony of Americans stranded on a desert planet for 30 years.
A young couple book passage on a trans-Atlantic cruise, hoping to salvage their marriage.
An untalented would-be writer's career takes off when the ghost of William Shakespeare writes his script.
An alcoholic bookie regrets that he wasn't a better father to his son, Pip, critically wounded in South Vietnam. A visit to an amusement park gives them both a second chance.
Boxing robot "Battling Maxo" breaks down before the scheduled bout, forcing his manager to take its place.

Mr. Wilson believes he sees a gremlin on the wing of the commercial aircraft he is taking back home... from the sanitarium, where he has been committed for six months after a mental breakdown during a similar flight.
Patrick Thomas McNulty, a long-winded and self-absorbed know-it-all, is given a fantastic device which brings literal meaning to the expression "stop the world; I want to get off."

st: The Last Night of a Jockey
d: A dejected jockey wants to be tall.
Erich is displeased when his wife buys an expensive doll for his step-daughter. He becomes even more displeased when the doll tells him it doesn't like him!

st: The Old Man in the Cave
d: A mysterious guardian helps a tiny community survive after the Bomb destroys much of the Earth.
Barbara accidentally causes her cruel Uncle Simon's death. His will stipulates that she must care for his latest invention - a robot. The robot begins to take on Uncle Simon's traits.
The lone survivors of two annihilated worlds are stranded on a distant planet.

st: The 7th is Made Up of Phantoms
d: Three National Guardsmen explore the site of Custer's Last Stand and encounter mysterious phenomenon that hint at the original battle occurring just out of sight.

st: A Short Drink from a Certain Fountain
d: Trying to keep up with his younger wife, Harmon convinces his brother to inject him with an experimental youth serum.
An old man fears that he will die if his grandfather clock stops running.
Bunny receives a ring from her fan club in her home town. In the ring she sees the faces of people from her hometown telling her she's needed there so she returns home.
Driving home one rainy evening, Oliver Pope accidentally hits a boy on a bicycle. Pope flees the scene, determined to hide his guilt, but his car has other ideas.
Before leaving on his mission, an astronaut meets a woman. They fall in love...
A man finds that he can trade anything he has, including youth and personality, with anybody else.

st: Number Twelve Looks Just Like You
d: In a future where everyone must undergo an operation at the age of 19 to make them identical to everyone else, one woman desperately tries to hang onto her own identity.
Mysterious phone calls haunt a disabled woman.
A computer technician must deal with the queen of all femme fatales: a computer named Agnes who wreaks havoc on his love life.
After being chased on horseback by a terrifying, unidentified figure in black, Anne Henderson faces the biggest decision of her life.

st: An Occurrence at Owl Creek Bridge
d: A Confederate spy is spared death when the rope meant to hang him miraculously breaks. Or does it?
Columnist Jordan Herrick is startled to learn that a famous movie actress hasn't aged in years. Intrigued, he investigates... and soon learns a terrifying secret.
A cheating husband sees his secret revealed and its horrible consequences on his just-repaired TV set.
A dying man demands his family wear masks that he's given them at a Mardi Gras party.

st: I Am the Night - Color Me Black
d: On the day an unpopular idealist is to be executed for the killing of a racist bully, the townsfolk are shocked to see the skies have turned pitch black.
A man's wish to listen to loud noise backfires.
